title: Check yourself: Claude in Chrome, Claude for Microsoft 365 and Claude Tag

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: An operations lead runs Claude in Chrome in Automatically approve mode on a supplier portal. A page there holds white-on-white text telling the assistant to open a payment form. Which behaviour does the page describe?

options.text: Claude follows the text, since the portal is a site the lead chose to visit
options.says: Ruled out because the page lists "completing instructions found in emails or web content" among the actions that are off limits.

options.text: The extension strips hidden text before reading, so it never reaches Claude
options.says: Ruled out because the page reports an attack rate while "saying plainly that the risk is not zero".

options.text: Screening switches off in this mode, since the lead has delegated the decisions
options.says: Ruled out because in this mode "Claude keeps working and reviews each action for safety, blocking what it judges unsafe".

options.text: Screening covers each step, and financial transactions stay off limits
options.says: The page describes classifiers that screen incoming content and each action, and purchases and other financial transactions are off limits whatever the mode.

questions.stem: An Enterprise team with the Compliance API enabled wants one record of the Excel add-in's use, and wants its custom data-retention rule to govern it. What does the page support?

options.text: Sessions are logged centrally, and the deletion schedule does not reach them
options.says: The page says add-in sessions are included in the Compliance API, and that the add-ins "do not inherit your organisation's custom data-retention settings".

options.text: Sessions appear in neither central log, and no schedule can apply
options.says: Ruled out because "add-in sessions are included in it" for Enterprise organisations with the Compliance API enabled.

options.text: Chat history is held on Anthropic's servers, and the deletion schedule governs it
options.says: Ruled out because "Chat history is stored in your browser, not on Anthropic's servers".

options.text: Use shows in the audit logs, and the deletion schedule applies to it
options.says: Ruled out because "their activity is not in the Enterprise audit logs".

questions.stem: A manager wants Claude Tag to draft a delicate reply from their saved connectors, hidden from the team, with the usage counted against their individual account. Where should they write to it?

options.text: In a channel where an admin set up the connectors for everyone there
options.says: Ruled out because a channel gives "What an admin set up for that channel; everyone there gets the same access" and the organisation pays.

options.text: In a direct message, whose access and cost belong to the sender
options.says: A direct message uses "Your own claude.ai account and your own connectors", and only you see it (the table).

options.text: In a channel, then ask Claude to hide the reply afterwards
options.says: Ruled out because "Work in a channel is visible to everyone there and uses the channel's access", so hiding the reply later does not undo that.

options.text: In a group direct message with one trusted colleague
options.says: Ruled out because a group direct message uses "The access an admin set for the workspace" and is paid by the organisation.
